- Y: 2 smaller add-ons awaiting legal wording

2) Marissa — please update the attached RYG tracker with owner and mitigation plan for the red item by EOD Tuesday.
3) Karthik / Finance — propose a short-term fallback (lifeboat) we can count on for forecast conservatism if PO slips >14 days.

I'll treat this as a forecast hygiene action: if we don't have an OK from procurement by EOD Friday we'll move the red item to the contingent bucket for this quarter. Attached: Velociti-RYG-tracker.xlsx (current status + owner columns).

Thanks — Hannah

Thanks all — read and agree with proposed steps. Proposed finance lifeboat (short):
- Option A (preferred): Hold 30% of committed capacity as an "implementation deposit" refundable against first invoice if PO executes by +30 days of target sign; otherwise treated as a 1-time credit for first month.
- Option B: If customer requires no deposit, we mark the red item as contingent in the quarter's forecast and apply a 10% conservative haircut to projected ARR.

I'll prepare the SLA exception form (to document the refundable holdback) and route to Legal/Finance. If Ellie/Procurement prefers, we can convert Option A to a refundable credit memo instead of a cash deposit.

Attachment: SLA-exception-form.pdf (draft)
